2427-4050-8077-8107.description:
Cast Raffine's Guidance from your graveyard by paying {W} due to Mana Matrix.
Sigil of the Empty Throne triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve Raffine's Guidance, attaching it to another creature you control.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the creature that has Raffine's Guidance attached, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Yarus, Roar of the Old Gods

222-527-5434-8095.easyPrerequisites:
You control a Saproling.
You control a creature with power 5 or greater.
222-527-5434-8095.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {1}{B}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Hammerhead twice by sacrificing Selvala and Slimefoot and Squee.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

1170-3536-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites:
Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-3536-5131-5330--202.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name the artifact.
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat from step 2

1809-3617-5144.description:
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Returned Pastcaller and exiling Ephemerate.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Time Walk from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Returned Pastcaller.
When Returned Pastcaller enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2034-3372-4742-6006.manaNeeded: {1}{W} if Enduring Vitality is not a creature
2034-3372-4742-6006.description:
If Enduring Vitality is not a creature, activate Zur by paying {1}{W}, causing Enduring Vitality to become a creature.
Activate Enduring Vitality by tapping it, adding {W}.
Activate Ashnod's Altar's second ability by sacrificing Enduring Vitality
When Enduring Vitality dies, it triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield as an enchantment.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

1563-3129-3899-7175.description:
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

1606-5143-6871.description:
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping it as it's a land due to Toph and another land you control.
Repeat.

944-2060-4415-6930.description:
Cast Stonecloaker by paying {W}.
Spider-Man India triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
When Stonecloaker enters, it triggers, returning itself from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to a creature that does not have summoning sickness and that has power 1 or greater

262-2438-3263-4853.description:
Activate the creature with Elemental Mastery attached by tapping it, creating a number of 1/1 Elemental creature tokens with haste equal to its power.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing an Elemental.
When the Elemental dies as an artifact due to Mycosynth Lattice, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping the creature with Elemental Mastery attached.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

215-1034-2060.description:
Cast Crystalline Crawler by paying {4}, ensuring to use four different colors of mana.
Lux Artillery triggers, giving Crystalline Crawler sunburst, causing it to enter with eight +1/+1 counters due to sunburst and its converge ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability eight times by removing eight +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Crystalline Crawler from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

1308-1563-2457-6791.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two 1/1 Insect creature tokens.
Activate the Insects by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Repeat

7-2438-4484-4871-5643.easyPrerequisites:
A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
You've cast a spell this turn.
7-2438-4484-4871-5643.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures that each have at least one +1/+1 counter on them.
7-2438-4484-4871-5643.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
Geralf's first ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Zombie Rogue creature token.
When the Zombie Rogue enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers,  putting a number of +1/+1 counters on the Zombie Rogue equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
When Ebondeath enters the battlefield, Geralf's second ability triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath equal to the number of other Zombies that entered the battlefield under your control.
Activate Carrion Feeder twice by sacrificing the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath.
When the Zombie Rogue and Ebondeath die, Pitiless Plunderer triggers twice, creating two Treasure tokens.
Resolve both Carrion Feeder abilities.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.
7-2438-4484-4871-5643.notes: This combo will steadily put more +1/+1 counters on Ebondeath and the Zombie Rogue token, eventually resulting in an infinite number of them.

1912-2034-3862-4013.easyPrerequisites: You do not control an Army.
1912-2034-3862-4013.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {C}, blinking Orcish Bowmasters.
When Orcish Bowmasters enters the battlefield, it triggers, dealing 1 damage to any target and creating a 0/0 Orc Army creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Orc Army, adding {C}{C}.
Repeat.

requires.n: Creature with "When this creature ETBs, create 2+ creature tokens"

3755-4499--85--92.description:
Activate Emiel by paying {3}, blinking the creature that creates creature tokens upon entering the battlefield.
When the creature enters, it triggers, creating at least two creature tokens.
Activate the creature and two tokens by tapping them, adding at least {3}.
Repeat.
3755-4499--85--92.notes: If the creature that creates tokens creates three or more tokens, this combo nets infinite untapped creature tokens. Otherwise, this combo nets infinite tapped creature tokens.

1329-1778-2178-5231.notablePrerequisites: Emry does not have summoning sickness.
1329-1778-2178-5231.description:
Activate Emry by tapping it, allowing you to cast Memnite from your graveyard this turn.
Cast Memnite from your graveyard by paying {0}.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing Memnite, adding {R}.
When Memnite dies, Emry triggers, untapping Emry.
Repeat.

290-1978-4832.description:
Activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Dreamstone Hedron.
Repeat

2292-2724-3582-3987.description:
Activate Kaya the Inexorable's first ability by putting a loyalty counter on it, putting a ghostform counter on Wormfang Manta.
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Wormfang Manta.
When Wormfang Manta dies, its second ability and its ghostform ability trigger.
Resolve the ghostform trigger, returning Wormfang Manta from your graveyard to your hand and creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Resolve the second trigger, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.
Cast Wormfang Manta by paying {5}{U}{U}.
Wormfang Manta's first ability does not trigger due to Torpor Orb.
Repeat each turn.

228-4277-5307.notablePrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
228-4277-5307.description:
Activate Cadaverous Bloom by exiling a card from your hand, adding {B}{B} or {G}{G}.
Ranar triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
Activate Skullclamp's equip ability by paying {1}, attaching it to the Spirit.
The Spirit dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Skullclamp triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

539-1183-4552.notablePrerequisites: Pentavus has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
539-1183-4552.description:
Activate Pentavus' first ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Pentavite artifact creature token.
Activate Pentavus' second ability by sacrificing the Pentavite, putting a +1/+1 counter on Pentavus.
Repeat.

1565-3263-4659-5003.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mintstrosity, adding {C}{C}.
When Mintstrosity dies, it and Nim Deathmantle triggers.
Resolve the Mintstrosity trigger, creating a Food artifact token.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing the Food, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger from step 2, causing you to pay {4} to return Mintstrosity from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

1283-1939-2034-3860.description:
Cast Lunarch Veteran from your graveyard for its disturb cost by paying {2}, causing it to enter the battlefield transformed as Luminous Phantom.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Luminous Phantom, adding {2}.
Because Overwhelming Splendor causes Luminous Phantom to lose all abilities, it is not exiled when it is sacrificed, and is returned to your graveyard as Lunarch Veteran.
Repeat.

886-1371-1396-3096.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three opponents.
You have at least eight cards in hand, or an opponent except the opponent directly to your right has at least six cards in hand.
Your deck size is less than 90, or each opponent has a deck size of 91 or less.
886-1371-1396-3096.description:
Cast Pure Intentions by paying {W}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Pure Intentions.
Resolve all Pure Intentions.
Cast Whispering Madness by paying {2}{U}{B}.
Hive Mind triggers, causing each opponent to create a copy of Whispering Madness.
Resolve the first opponent's copy of Whispering Madness, causing each player to discard their hand and draw cards equal to the greatest number of cards discarded this way.
Each player who did not control Whispering Madness's Pure Intentions triggers.
Resolve all Pure Intentions, causing you and the opponents to return to their hand all cards discarded by Whispering Madness.
Repeat from step 6 for each remaining Whispering Madness until you either draw from an empty library, causing you to win the game due to Jace, or until your opponents lose the game due to drawing from an empty library.

508-4702.notablePrerequisites: Splinter Twin attached to Black Carriage.
508-4702.description:
During your upkeep, activate Black Carriage by tapping it, creating a token copy of itself with haste.
Activate the nontoken Black Carriage by sacrificing the token Black Carriage, untapping the nontoken Black Carriage.
Repeat.

2808-3388.description:
Cast Moritte by paying {3}{G}{U}, choosing to have it enter the battlefield as a copy of Enduring Scalelord with two +1/+1 counters on it.
Enduring Scalelord triggers, putting +1/+1 counter on itself.
Moritte triggers, putting +1/+1 counter on itself.
Repeat from step 2.

738-1778-1969-4659.description:
Sacrifice Memnite to Krark-Clan Ironworks, adding {C}{C}.
Grave Pact triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Glissa triggers at least once, allowing you to return Memnite to your hand.
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Repeat until your opponents no longer control any creatures.
